mechanical_binding_checks.details: Independently recomputed byte counts and SHA256 for every binding. Repository scientific/execution inputs equal committed HEAD blobs; scientific and execution manifests equal their original checkpoint blobs. Current source revisions, Python link/resolved bytes, platform, limits, workspace authority and fixed schedule match. Nested preflight and retained smoke bindings also match committed evidence.

validity_reasoning: Pi family has n domains Sort0 and terminal Sort0; each Pi has type Sort1 by repeated imax(1,1)=1. Value expanded size is 2n+1.

Let family has n bindings of type Sort1; first value Sort0 and later values the immediately preceding variable, ending in the latest variable. Each value and the whole term have type Sort1; expanded size is 3n+1.

Separate stdlib-only auditor reconstructs exact source and export graph, safe total single definition, structured declaration name, type/value, prior references, interned nodes, scope and metrics. Unsafe, partial, opaque, extra, hidden, malformed and wrong-expression inputs reject. Deep synthetic input is audited iteratively.
Pre-freeze actual term tests use disjoint n=2,3,601 fixtures; selected schedule tests inspect metadata only. No selected source/export files, construction attempts or checker runs are present.
profiles_and_measurement: Both observers must check the same exact single safe-definition export with exit zero and count one. Official source replay skips unsafe/partial declarations, so exact safe-total audit is essential.

Nanoda uses the exact serial strict configuration with axioms and native extensions disabled. Its positive acceptance witness under this new configuration remains a separate preregistered smoke gate before scientific launch.
Each profile receives three metadata-only baselines before and three after science. These measure startup plus empty parse/check; there is no isolated import estimate or RSS subtraction.
Actual-host synthetic direct-supervisor preflight replays as ACCEPTED with six positive live samples and complete cleanup. Bound measurement code and runtime match the unchanged post-run attestation.
Sampled process-group RSS can miss peaks, is non-atomic and can double-count shared pages. wait4 accounting high-water may include accounted-for descendants and is not a simultaneous group peak.

Valid scientific limits pause immediately for independent exact diagnosis before skipping larger same-family/profile sizes; monitor, accounting, timeout-attribution or cleanup faults require preserved same-item engineering repair.
